In many cases, the face changes slightly between images, making it difficult to produce a consistent fashion portfolio or professional brand identity.With the latest generation of AI image models in 2026, platforms like ChatGPT Image, Google Gemini AI, Midjourney V7, FLUX, Leonardo AI, Ideogram, and Recraft AI can produce highly consistent character portraits—provided you use well-structured prompts.The two premium prompts below are designed specifically for Identity Lock. They instruct the AI to preserve the same facial anatomy, hairstyle, skin tone, age, and overall appearance across multiple fashion looks, making them ideal for portfolio creation, influencer branding, lookbooks, social media campaigns, and commercial fashion concepts.Whether you’re building a personal brand or showcasing AI-generated fashion ideas, these prompts provide magazine-quality results with a luxury editorial aesthetic.What Is an AI Fashion Identity Collage?An AI Fashion Identity Collage is a single composition where the same person appears in multiple outfits while maintaining a consistent identity.Unlike ordinary AI portraits, these collages emphasize:Same face across every imageConsistent hairstyle and skin toneMultiple fashion styles in one layoutEditorial magazine designLuxury studio photographyCommercial-quality presentationThis style has become increasingly popular on Pinterest, Instagram, LinkedIn, Behance, and digital portfolio platforms because it showcases versatility while preserving a recognizable identity.Why Identity Consistency MattersOne of the biggest weaknesses of many AI image generators is subtle facial drift. Without clear instructions, the model may alter the eyes, jawline, hairstyle, or skin tone between generations.The Identity Lock section in these prompts minimizes that issue by explicitly asking the model to preserve:Face shapeHairline and hairstyleEyebrowsEye colorNoseLipsJawlineBeard density (for male portraits)Skin toneFacial proportionsAgeNatural skin textureBody proportionsFacial expressionThis makes the final collage appear as though it features professional photos of the same individual rather than six different people.AI Platforms Compatible with These PromptsThese prompts work well with:AI ToolPerformanceChatGPT Image⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Google Gemini AI⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Midjourney V7⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐FLUX⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Leonardo AI⭐⭐⭐⭐☆Ideogram⭐⭐⭐⭐☆Recraft AI⭐⭐⭐⭐☆Prompt 1 – Boy Fashion Identity CollageThis prompt creates a luxury editorial collage featuring the same young Indian man in six different premium outfits while maintaining complete identity consistency.Key HighlightsSix stylish fashion looksLuxury magazine compositionPremium editorial designCEO-inspired hero portraitHigh-end commercial photographyMinimal white studio backgroundHDR cinematic lighting8K ultra-r
